Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with
complaints of low back pain radiating into the right buttock and posterior thigh.
Initial evaluation documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and a restricted lumbar
range of motion, consistent with a lumbar strain. Neurological screening showed intact
sensation, reflexes, and strength in the lower extremities, while straight leg raise
testing produced mild discomfort on the right. Imaging findings were reviewed, and the
relationship between these symptoms and the collision has not yet been clearly
established, so causation remains under review. The patient has no known prior injury
or treatment inovlving the lumbar region. Care has been provided over 30 visits,
consisting of manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home program
instruction. Progress has been gradual, and the course of treatment has run somewhat
longer than typically epxected for a strain of this type. Billing records reflect
single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Ongoing reassessment is
planned to determine functional status and whether futrher care is warranted.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
